idea-plugin.name: Claude Relay
idea-plugin.description:
Claude Relay — Claude Code, native in your JetBrains IDE

A native chat panel that drives the official Claude Code CLI from inside IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, Rider and the rest of the JetBrains family — the side-panel experience you'd get in VS Code, without leaving your IDE or living in the terminal.

Highlights

  • Streaming chat with live tool activity — edits, commands, and file reads as they happen
  • Agent & Ask modes — let Claude edit and run commands, or keep it strictly read-only
  • Editor-aware — auto-attaches your current selection, so "explain/refactor this" just works
  • Attach files & images — pick a file, or paste a screenshot straight into the prompt
  • Project context — picks up your CLAUDE.md, agents, skills and slash commands automatically
  • Session history — resume past conversations from a built-in picker
  • Model & permission selectors, with live usage and limits

Requires the Claude Code CLI installed separately (npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code) and an active Claude subscription.

☕ Free and open source (MIT). Source, issues, and contributions: github.com/Chelayel/claude-relay.

Independent and unofficial — not affiliated with Anthropic. Part of the “Relay” family of IDE companions by Chelayel.

1.0.3 — Compatibility fix for upcoming IntelliJ releases (replaced a platform API scheduled for removal). Shift+Enter inserts a newline.

1.0.2 — Claude Relay is now free and open source (MIT). Source & contributions: github.com/Chelayel/claude-relay.

1.0.1 — Fixed intermittent “Project context” bar visibility.

1.0.0 — First release: native Claude Code chat panel with streaming transcript & tool activity, Agent & Ask modes, single-select agent persona, editor-aware context, file & image attachments, project agents/skills/commands, session history, and model/permission selectors.
